headline: Define the Purpose of the Area
alternativeHeadline: A space cannot be good at everything. Before you move a thing, give it one clear job in a single honest sentence.
description: Before you sort a space, decide what it is for. This chapter shows how to write a one-sentence Purpose Statement that becomes the rule every keep-or-go decision is measured against, diagnoses the everything-space, and explains how a clear purpose sets a space's limits and prevents re-cluttering.
keywords: how to organize a space with a purpose
